mechanistic_hypothesis: A positive RPE delivered at a scored second press reinforces relay-to-motor eligibility left by an earlier unscored null press. That first press can move earlier while the 200-ms cooldown creates an apparently improved second press, then become too early. An immediate negative action-cost signal for a null DOWN should weaken activity causal to the unscored action and reduce premature first crossings.
intervention: Diagnostic-only overlay on game.apply_action. When and only when a training-phase DOWN returns disposition null_press, apply a signed dopamine-like amplitude of -1.0 through the unchanged production plasticity method at that tick. This magnitude equals the current centered utility of a MISS; it is fixed without a search. Do not change the judgement utility, global reward predictor, game score, sensory input, topology, motor readout, eligibility rule or weight bounds. Never deliver this cost in the frozen phase. Record each cost event, applied weight changes and null action.
map_and_training: Use exact overnight_synthetic.json map generator and choices: 24 training notes and 16 frozen notes, readout threshold 10, unchanged exploration probability and learning parameters. These are already-used development seeds; this is not held-out M2 evidence.
controls: legacy_on has no null cost; null_cost_off disables all plasticity, including the action-cost update; null_cost_shuffled uses the existing deterministic shuffled schedule of the null_cost_on training judgement utilities while retaining the same fixed null-cost rule. Conditions share seed, map, cue gains and global-tick exploration stream construction.
primary_outcomes: mean absolute timing error among frozen hits
number and timing of first frozen DOWN per note
secondary_outcomes: null-cost event count and applied L1
progression_rule: Treat as a promising development mechanism only if null_cost_on improves frozen GOOD+ in at least 6/8 seeds against legacy_on and both matched cost controls, reduces premature first-DOWN/null behavior without creating silence, and lowers pooled hit MAE toward the existing 40-ms M2 target. This 8-seed check cannot pass M2; if it fails, preserve the failure and do not tune cost amplitude on these outcomes.
scope_limit: One cost magnitude, one eight-seed development cohort, no parameter search, no production model edit, no fly-circuit inference. A separate fresh held-out predeclared gate is required before any M2 claim.
